summary: Workhorse Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an Omnibus Amendment to its existing Credit Agreements with Motive GM Holdings II LLC. The amendment increases the Cash Flow Credit Agreement commitment from $10M to $20M, defers interest on the additional $10M loan until after September 30, 2026, and reduces the Customer Order Credit Agreement commitment from $40M to $30M. The filing also notes a CEO departure agreement. This is a routine debt facility amendment and a standard departure arrangement, not a special situation. No transaction, shareholder vote, or strategic catalyst is present. The filing is a ordinary modification of financing terms.
